channel.description: St. Croix Prep ChatGPT Records Viewer updates

item.title: Version 1.6.9
item.description:
Version 1.6.9

• Gives toolbar actions native macOS pill/bubble styling instead of floating bare icons.
• Groups Paste/Open, CSV/Transcript, and Threads/Messages inside rounded segmented pills with vertical dividers.
• Keeps Settings as a compact rounded bubble.
• Makes Retrieve a solid green wide pill with white iconography and a lighter green hover state.
• Adds more horizontal breathing room to custom toolbar items so the Customize Toolbar palette is spaced more like Apple Mail.
